name: musl
description: Lightweight, fast, and standards-conformant C standard library implementation, designed as a musl-libc alternative to glibc for static and dynamic linking.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
